adjudication.rationale: The diff does remove the `get "users"` route from the admin groups routes in `config/routes.rb` (replaced by `delete "members"` and `put "members"`), so any existing callers of `GET /admin/groups/users` would indeed start getting 404s. However, the finding’s claim of “no replacement registered” is overstated: member listing is now performed via the non-admin endpoint `/groups/:name/members.json` (`Discourse.Group#findMembers` calls `/groups/<name>/members.json`, and `GroupsController#members` now returns `{ members, meta }`). The main actionable concern is backward-compatibility for out-of-tree consumers of the removed admin route, which the diff does not address (no alias/deprecation).
